textRuns.value: Default, loss and ROI figures use matured loans only (the full term has ended), so outcomes are final; loans issued from 2016 are mostly still running. Scatter: one bubble per sub-grade; the dashed line is the average default rate of the sub-grades shown. Hover a bubble for the grade tooltip; right-click → Drill through → Loan Detail. ROI columns drill from tier to grade to sub-grade; the dashed line is the 25th percentile. Bottom row: prepayment by grade and term, and loans priced outside their sub-grade's usual band.
